email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Service Assistant role at your Albany head office. With a background in e-commerce and digital marketing, I've spent the past year managing online stores, handling customer enquiries, and keeping product catalogues and content accurate and up to date. I'm comfortable with email and live chat support, and I pick up new tools like Zendesk quickly.

What draws me to this role is the mix of customer care and behind-the-scenes operations. I enjoy solving problems, keeping detailed records, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. I'm organised, proactive, and happy to help wherever needed, whether that's assisting store teams or coordinating courier supplies.

I'm available to work through the Christmas and New Year period and would love the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Customer Service Assistant position at your Albany head office. With hands-on experience in e-commerce and digital marketing, I've developed a strong mix of customer-facing and operational skills that I believe would make me a valuable addition to your team.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage online stores on Shopify and WooCommerce, handle product catalogues, and respond to customer enquiries. I've built and maintained websites, written and published content, and used tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. While I haven't used Zendesk specifically, I'm confident in my ability to learn it quickly, having worked with various CMS and support platforms. I'm detail-oriented, comfortable with Microsoft Office, and pride myself on clear, friendly communication.

The responsibilities of this role appeal to me because they combine customer care with logistics and store support. I enjoy the variety of a busy workday and take satisfaction in resolving issues promptly and accurately. My experience coordinating content and managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment has sharpened my time-management and problem-solving skills. I'm also a proactive team player who's always willing to lend a hand.

I'm available to work during the Christmas and New Year period and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

• Detail-oriented: implemented technical SEO audits, structured data, and content management with a focus on precision and quality

• Available for Christmas/New Year period; fluent English and strong written communication skills
